context_needs: A circle of fifths chart that labels relative minors (printed or on screen)

document.evidence_note: Research status was degraded (one fetch failure), and the three supplied sources are marked unverified. Only the C major / A minor pairing is grounded: one source shows C major with 'Relative: A minor' and no sharps or flats, and another labels the top of the circle 'C major / A minor'. The objective and checklist are narrowed to that instance; any wider rule about relative minors is excluded as a
exclusions: Does not teach finding the relative minor for any major key other than C major; the supplied sources evidence only the C major / A minor pair.
Does not teach the 'minor third below' rule or counting three steps counter-clockwise, since no supplied source states that procedure.
Does not cover parallel minors, key-signature construction, chord function, or using the circle for modulation.
Does not include playing, singing or ear training, and makes no listening claim.
Does not assess, grade or certify the learner; the single check is a self-run verification checklist.
No claim is made that this plan was validated or that its time estimate reflects measured attainment.
document.learner_outcome: In one short sitting, the learner can point to C major at the top of a circle of fifths chart, name A minor as its relative minor, and state that the pair shares the same key signature (no sharps or flats). This plan deliberately stops at the C major / A minor instance that the supplied sources show; it does not claim a general procedure for other keys.

evidence_criteria: Points to C major at the top of the chart and reads its 'Relative' entry as A minor.
States that C major and A minor share the same key signature: no sharps or flats.
Explains, in their own words, that the chart lists the relative minor alongside the major key rather than as a separate key signature.
objectives.title: Name A minor as the relative minor of C major on a circle of fifths chart

hazards: Screen use: keep sessions short and take a break if the learner reports eye strain.

supervision_notes: An adult should confirm the chart in use actually labels relative minors before the learner starts the checklist.

time_estimate.rationale: A single 20-minute sitting is a light-pace estimate for reading one labelled entry on a chart and saying it back. This is an authoring estimate, not a measured attainment time; no benchmark was supplied and research was degraded, so confidence is low.
